name: How we work
title: How we work
lead: From the first call to support after launch, the process runs in eight steps. Before any work starts you see the scope, timeline and payment plan in writing.

steps.title: Intro call
steps.text: I listen to what you need and how you work today. This call is free.

steps.title: Process analysis
steps.text: I review how the work runs today, the files and screens in use, and we agree on what moves into software.

steps.title: Written proposal
steps.text: I present the scope, phases, timeline, payment plan and what is out of scope in one document. A sample is at the bottom of this page.

steps.title: Agreement and first payment
steps.text: Work starts once the proposal is approved.

steps.title: Development with weekly demos
steps.text: Each finished phase is put on a test environment for your review, and your feedback shapes the next phase.

steps.title: Interim delivery
steps.text: The first part of the work goes live; measurement and ad connections are set up.

steps.title: Testing, training and final launch
steps.text: After end-to-end testing and a security check, I train your team to use the system.

steps.title: Maintenance and support
steps.text: For one month after the final launch I provide free maintenance and bug fixes.

termsTitle: What stays the same on every project

terms.title: Code and accounts in your name
terms.text: From day one the source code lives in a GitHub account opened in your name. Server, domain and Google accounts are opened in your name too.

terms.title: Fixed price
terms.text: The price in the proposal does not change. Requests outside the scope are priced separately, by written agreement.

terms.title: Every phase reviewed by you
terms.text: Each phase is presented on a test environment; we move on after your feedback.

terms.title: Support after launch
terms.text: One month of free maintenance and bug fixes after the final launch.

items: A separate page for each service; service pages are designed as Google Ads landing pages.

numbered.title: Delivery and acceptance
numbered.text: Each finished phase is put on a test environment for the client's review. The client gives feedback within 5 working days; without feedback in that time the phase counts as accepted.

numbered.title: Schedule
numbered.text: Durations are estimates in working days. If inputs expected from the client are late, the schedule moves by the length of the delay; the price does not change.

numbered.title: Payment
numbered.text: Payments follow the payment plan. For overdue payments the contractor reserves the right to pause work until payment is made.

numbered.title: Intellectual property
numbered.text: From day one the source code is kept in a GitHub account opened in the client's name. Once the total price is paid in full, the source code and all rights belong to the client.

numbered.title: Accounts and access
numbered.text: GitHub, server, Cloudflare, Google (Analytics, Ads, Search Console) and domain accounts are opened in the client's name; the contractor works with developer access during the project.

numbered.title: Maintenance and support
numbered.text: Free maintenance and bug fixes are provided for 1 month after the final launch. Small features requested in that time are not charged; large feature requests are priced separately.

numbered.title: Privacy notices
numbered.text: Privacy notices are prepared by the contractor as templates; legal approval is the client's responsibility.

numbered.title: Confidentiality
numbered.text: The parties do not share commercial information obtained through the project with third parties.
